about: What a Markdown renderer that draws HTML comments as text must drop from a README: every HTML comment block whose first word is a marker word. Each case is a document (`markdown`) and the same document with exactly the lines of its marker comments removed (`shown`): a renderer passes a case when it renders `markdown` as it renders `shown`. Additions only: a new case or a new word, never a changed or removed one.
